title: SDLC Requirement Identifier v1
description: The canonical identifier of an authoritative requirement declared in a work-item.json requirements.items array.
$comment: RequirementIdentifier has the exact form {WorkItemId}_REQ_{three-digit-number}. The identifier is a direct syntactic reference type; local semantic resolution loads only .docs/work-items/{WorkItemId}/work-item.json and selects exactly one requirements.items object with the matching id.
